question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="]" open="["><mi>t</mi></mfenced></math> denote the greatest integer <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>≤</mo><mi>t</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="}" open="{"><mi>t</mi></mfenced></math> denote the fractional part of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi></math>. Then integral value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math> for which the left hand limit of the function <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mfenced><mi>x</mi></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfenced close="]" open="["><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>α</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mfenced close="]" open="["><mi>x</mi></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mfenced close="}" open="{"><mi>x</mi></mfenced></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mfenced close="]" open="["><mi>x</mi></mfenced><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mfenced close="]" open="["><mi>x</mi></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mfenced close="}" open="{"><mi>x</mi></mfenced></mrow></mfrac></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> is equal to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac></math> is _____

solution.text:
Given,

fx=1+x+α2x+x+x-12x+x

limx→0-fx=α-43

limx→0-1+x+αx+x+x+x-12x+x=α-43

⇒0+α-1-2-1=α-43

⇒2-1α=α-43

⇒α+1α=103

On solving above equation we get,

⇒α=3;α∈I
